title: 第13章  空间潮汐第14章  防卫证猛兽岭
slug: 从龙象般若功开始创武成圣
content_zh:
【铁布衫】
【简介：融汇贯通诸多横练功法，在此基础上推陈出新，不仅有锻体炼身之效，还可助人淬炼武道意志。】
【品质：一阶中品。】
【武学效果：*****】
【修行体验：*】
【实用价值：****】
【创新指数：****】
【功德值：78（可自由调整时间流速，在武道圣胎内进行为期78天的武道修行。）】
【评分：89。】
【评价：有坚韧不拔之心者，当成钢铁无俦之躯！】
······
当铁布衫的检测结果，显现在大厅中时。
苏锦微微昂头，满足的看向周围过来看他笑话的同事们。
听他们嘴里的惊叹声，只觉无比的悦耳动听，舒服的不知所以。
“89分，差一点点就是一阶上品武学啊！”
“四星创新指数，代表这门武学几乎没有同阶替代品，独一无二的横练功法？！”
“就是修行体验差了点，可能会劝退大多数武者，要不然这铁布衫绝对能算一阶上品乃至极品武学！”
“苏锦这侄子可了不得了，这才多大，就能创出这样的武学来。”
满足之后，苏锦又品尝到了之前苏老实经历过的烦恼。
有数位家里有儿有女的同事找过来，让他帮忙问问苏青武徒的事。

对此，苏锦没有一概拒绝。
能在武道局任职的人，要么有实力，要么有背景，儿女也都差不了。
完全可以将他们的信息先收集起来，交给苏青慢慢挑选。
对此，他那些同事们也都能理解。
这就跟相亲一样。
苏青展现了他的优势，自然有选择相亲对象的权利。
而相亲对象们，也不是说他选了就一定跟他了，双方还要见个面，聊一聊，再谈后续。
不对，为什么不直接相亲呢！
十六岁也不小了，再看这小伙子，身材虽然瘦弱了些，但长得却是俊逸出尘，关键是前途亮的吓人啊！
想到这里，本来还觉得刚创出一门武学的苏青，不配他儿女去做武徒的人。
也都跑过去跟苏锦要了苏青的联系方式。
问过苏青意见后，苏锦索性将他的V信号，发到了武道局职工群里。
这下子，群里也热闹起来。
都知道苏锦有了一位开创出武学，引来功德加身的侄子。
与此同时，苏青的V信上，也多出了一个个好友申请。
但他现在哪有空加好友。
身边还有个好哥哥等他认呢！
“苏老弟，三年同学，一生兄弟，作为第一高中本届唯二的两个创武师，你我兄弟未来创武路上，可要相互扶持才是！”
王天宏热切的拉着苏青的手，比他亲哥哥还要热切。
而苏青对这位第一高中的风云人物，出入校园前呼后拥的王大少，没好感，也没恶感。

没好感是因为三年前，王大少也跟现在一样把他当亲兄弟。
但不出三月，这位老哥就让人把他送的挂历要了回去。
那挂历还不是武仙真迹呢！
真一点格局都没有！
没恶感是这位王大少，从来不在普通人身上浪费时间。
content_en:
【Iron shirt】
[Introduction: Integrating many horizontal training techniques, and innovating on this basis, it not only has the effect of training the body, but also helps people temper their martial arts will. 】
[Quality: first-level mid-grade. 】
[Martial arts effect: *****]
[Practice experience:*]
[Practical value: ****]
[Innovation Index: ****]
[Merit value: 78 (You can freely adjust the time flow rate and conduct 78 days of martial arts practice in the martial arts holy womb.)]
[Rating: 89. 】
[Evaluation: Those who have a persevering heart should be treated as a body of steel! 】
······
When the test results of Iron Cloth Shirt appeared in the hall.
Su Jin raised his head slightly and looked with satisfaction at the colleagues around him who came to watch his joke.
Listening to the exclamations from their mouths, I felt it was extremely pleasant and comfortable.
"A score of 89, just shy of reaching the first level of high-grade martial arts!"
"The four-star innovation index means that this martial arts has almost no substitutes at the same level. It is a unique horizontal training method?!"
"It's just that the training experience is a bit poor, which may dissuade most warriors. Otherwise, this iron cloth shirt can definitely be regarded as a first-class or even top-grade martial arts!"
"This nephew Su Jin is amazing. He's so young, he can create such a martial arts."
After being satisfied, Su Jin tasted the troubles that Su Laoshi had experienced before.
Several colleagues with children at home came over and asked him to help ask Su Qing about martial arts disciples.
Su Jin did not refuse all of them.
Those who can serve in the Martial Arts Bureau must either have strength or background, and their children are also the same.
It is entirely possible to collect their information first and let Su Qing slowly select it.
His colleagues also understand this.
It's just like a blind date.
Su Qing showed his advantages and naturally had the right to choose a blind date.
As for the blind date, it doesn't mean that they will definitely follow him if he chooses them. Both parties have to meet, have a chat, and then discuss the follow-up.
No, why not just go on a blind date!
Sixteen years old is not young anymore. Look at this young man. Although he is a little thinner, he looks handsome. The most important thing is that he has a scary bright future!
Thinking of this, I originally felt that Su Qing, who had just created a martial arts, was not worthy of having his children become martial arts disciples.
They all ran over to Su Jin and asked for Su Qing's contact information.
After asking Su Qing for his opinion, Su Jin simply sent his V signal to the Martial Arts Bureau employee group.
Now, the group became lively.
Everyone knew that Su Jin had a nephew who pioneered martial arts and attracted meritorious deeds.
At the same time, Su Qing's V-letter also had more friend applications.
But he doesn't have time to make friends now.
There is a good brother waiting for him to recognize him!
"Brother Su, we have been classmates for three years and brothers for life. As the only two martial arts masters in the current class of First High School, you and I, brothers, must support each other on our journey of martial arts creation in the future!"
Wang Tianhong held Su Qing's hand eagerly, even more eagerly than his own brother.
Su Qing, on the other hand, had neither a favorable impression nor a bad impression of this influential figure in the No. 1 High School, Mr. Wang, who was cheered and cheered before leaving the campus.
The reason for the bad impression is that three years ago, Young Master Wang regarded him as his brother as he does now.
But within March, this old man asked someone to take back the calendar he had given.
That calendar is not the original work of Wuxian!
There really is no pattern at all!
No offense, this Young Master Wang never wastes time on ordinary people.
